# P35.41a insert: Phase-4 fresh-context review record

- **What:** the `decompose-spec mode=extend` Phase-4 adversarial review of the single run-time insert P35.41a (sequence 320a) and its companion texts: the manifest row and Plan-extensions line, the LEDGER texts, the DEFERRALS row texts, and the driver prompt.
- **Reviewer:** a fresh-context subagent with no authoring memory. It read only the drafts and the repository at `r11/P35.41-freshness-semantics-v2` (`62601e55`), and it was read-only: `git show`/`log`/`grep`/`ls-tree`, no index or ref writes, no repository scripts run.
- **Author:** the drafting research session (Claude Code). It applied every finding below. No finding was rejected.
- **Dates:** taken from `date -u` on 2026-10-20 (rounds 1–3).

## Round 1: VERDICT FIXES (5 major, 11 minor, 1 nit)

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | major | § Files and D3 left out the ADR bookkeeping that `make docs-check` enforces: the Appendix F source, the spec rebuilt by `BUILD.sh`, `ADR_TRIGGERS.csv` and the BACKLOG csv/md. The ADR-218 commit `a0270540` shows the full set. | Fixed. D3 and § Files now list each file. The spec is regenerated, never hand-edited. |
| 2 | major | A fixed `--basetemp $RUNNER_TEMP/p<k>` would let a nested self-test wipe a running partition. Self-tests also inherited `GITHUB_*` variables. | Fixed. Each invocation now gets a fresh `mkdtemp`, and every subprocess in the self-tests runs with a scrubbed environment (AC 2, AC 4). |
| 3 | major | The symlink condition looked only at records paths. The real gap was a non-records link pointing into records. | Fixed. Condition (7) now refuses any symlink or gitlink in the tree, and an AC 4 case covers it. |
| 4 | major | The texts did not say where the insert commit goes, nor its preconditions. Writing it while `nextTicket` is P35.41 overflows the V11 orient probe. | Fixed. The preconditions, the branch and first-commit rule (precedent `445c19b7`), the V11 warning and the commit trailer are now stated. |
| 5 | major | The operator decision text offered two reused Lighthouse steps, but the contract reuses only the fixture-mode step. | Fixed. The research note, the GATE rows and the driver prompt now all name only the fixture-mode `Performance budgets` step. |
| 6 | minor | The behaviour of the new steps under `bash -eo pipefail`, and their environment mapping, were unspecified. | Fixed. The exact YAML is in D2.6, with guarded commands, `id: perfrec`, and the save step gated on its outcome. |
| 7 | minor | The partition runner could pass vacuously. | Fixed. Each partition must print a `passed` summary line, and `PYTEST_PARTITIONS_CMD` is barred from `ci.yml` and the `Makefile`. |
| 8 | minor | Wall-clock assertions (`tests/api/test_store_pg.py` L550, L795) can fail under CPU contention. | Fixed. A contention rule was added: rebalance the partitions, never change a threshold. |
| 9 | minor | AC 1's union check did not cover the real tree. | Fixed. AC 8 now records collect-only node-id multiset evidence. |
| 10 | minor | The `AGENTS.md` L60/L75 and `Makefile` L6 statements would become untrue. | Fixed. These lines are now allowed and required edits. |
| 11 | minor | The coupling-lint exemption wording was ambiguous, and a stale allow-list would be silent. | Fixed. The wording is tightened, a test checks the committed tree, and stale entries are reported. |
| 12 | minor | Inputs outside the git tree were missing: the runner image and its Chrome. | Fixed. An `image` record key and condition (9) were added, plus a residual. |
| 13 | minor | There was no H2 fallback for a cache miss. | Fixed. One retry is allowed; a second miss is a stop-and-ask. |
| 14 | minor | The companions disagreed on optional answers and lacked the commit trailer; the records definition was ambiguous. | Fixed. |
| 15 | minor | The review report sits on a corpus surface of the claim lint (`live_claims.toml`). | Fixed. A corpus check now runs before `git add`. |
| 16 | minor | The cost baseline was a projection, not the measured actuals. | Fixed. `D-P35.41a-1` now uses the measured figures (295/312 billed minutes per ticket). |
| 17 | nit | Small corrections: the H2-branch-ci anchor (L633), the H3 wording, a tab recipe plus `.PHONY`, `--root`, the action-major floor, and filtered log reads. | Fixed. |

## Round 2: VERDICT FIXES (1 major, 6 minor, 2 nits)

The reviewer confirmed that all round-1 fixes landed.

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | major | The driver prompt allowed a silent placement change after a later row, which conflicts with the verbatim D1 row. | Fixed. A changed placement is now a stop-and-ask, recorded as its own confirmation row, and every placement-bound text is updated to match. |
| 2 | minor | A precondition required P35.41's CI read to be recorded before the step that records it. | Fixed. The read must be green; it is recorded in the boundary-confirm entry that follows. |
| 3 | minor | The runner-image binding passed when `ImageOS`/`ImageVersion` were empty. | Fixed. The regex now requires both parts. `record` refuses a malformed value, and condition (9) fails on it, with an AC 4 case. |
| 4 | minor | One operating clause still told the worker to create the branch. | Fixed. |
| 5 | minor | The DEFERRALS notes had gone stale against the contract. | Fixed. The notes now point at the contract as the single source. |
| 6 | minor | The driver prompt referenced this review file before it existed. | Fixed. This file now exists. `/Users/stevenvitali/eleutheria-ci-handoff` is left for the operator by design. |
| 7 | minor | The parity-test exemptions were not named. | Fixed. Exactly four full-form entries are named, each with its reason. |
| 8 | nit | The fallback-cut arithmetic did not match the size budget. | Fixed. Both use a 55-line YAML estimate, so the cut line is about 360. |
| 9 | nit | The push and boundary-confirm steps were in an awkward order. | Fixed. The boundary-confirm commit comes first, then one push. |

## Round 3: VERDICT APPROVE (0 major, 2 minor, 1 nit)

The reviewer confirmed that all round-2 fixes landed and found no new problem. The contract head is 1,407 B, which keeps the V11 estimate. The texts agree on:
- D1–D4 required and D5–D7 optional;
- kind `confirmation`;
- the commit trailer;
- the branch and first-commit rule;
- the fixture-mode-only scope.

The reviewer also checked this file against the claim-lint assert terms and found no hit.

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | minor | The placement-change list missed some placement-bound mentions of `320a`. | Fixed. A grep-and-update bullet now names every hit. |
| 2 | minor | This section pointed at text that did not exist yet, and the file is frozen once committed. | Fixed. This section now holds the round-3 record. |
| 3 | nit | The contract's own byte count in § Load was stale. | Fixed: ≈ 50,200 B. |

The insert is approved for the driver's insert commit.
